rules: wave W0 is the golden extension alone, recorded on the old code
at most 4 steps in a wave; the steps of a wave touch no common file
exactly one step of a wave touches robot_agent/core/planning/assist_loop.py and tools/arch_baseline.json
a step starts only when the steps in `needs` are merged and the cassettes it names exist
the first golden mismatch or red suite stops the run
CHANGELOG.md, docs indexes and .dev-principles*.json are written by the wave's integrator, never by a step
notes: Plan of the level-B core generalization after the adversarial review (29 findings; see section 'Review of this design' of generalize_core_design.md). Wave W0 is the golden extension alone, on the old code. assist_loop.py is touched by exactly one step in a wave (22 such steps), so the waves are as many as those steps; the other streams ride along, at most 4 steps a wave, file-disjoint by construction (one file per pack section, one scenario set and one mutation set per step). Shared files no step edits: CHANGELOG.md, docs indexes and .dev-principles*.json are written by the integrator of a wave from the steps' reports; tools/arch_baseline.json is updated only by the wave's assist_loop.py step. Equivalence cassettes are recorded only in W0; a feature cassette of an opt-in step is recorded by that step and reviewed as the specification of the new behaviour. Stop rule: the first golden mismatch or red suite stops the run. Sizes are estimates (about 10 percent); the rule is the sign. Smaller cut (removes fit G1 to G6 with the opt-in steps): waves W0 to W8, assist_loop.py about 3240 lines; with S14 and S16b (to W10) about 3050; all waves: about 370 (350 to 450), not 300.

steps.title: Extend the goldens on the old code (harness capture sections, made-up pack fakeline, cassettes, mutations, snapshots)
steps.risk: low for the product, real for the schedule
steps.golden_coverage: the step IS the coverage
steps.notes: Wave 0, alone. Cassettes: NEW files only, the 21 that exist are never touched. Every equivalence cassette is recorded on generalize-core at 65124d0 (no production commit merged) and carries that commit; tests/golden/base_commits.json lists it and a new test checks it. harness.py and scenarios.py change by ADDED code only (FORMAT stays 1: tests/golden/test_golden_cassettes.py:24 compares every cassette with harness.FORMAT): a scenario key `capture` (planner_io, llm_kw, prompts, reconcile), a key `env`, a key `pack` (calls robot.use_pack, which Step S02 adds), ROBOT_AGENT_* cleared before every run, scenario sets and mutation sets loaded from one file per step. Order inside the step: harness, fakeline, the cassettes in the order of the waves that need them, the mutations. Done only when the 21 old cassettes replay identically, every new mutation is CAUGHT and the full suite is green. A path the fakes cannot play is listed in the report and the step that needs it is not started.

steps.title: The pack schema (whole), the loader with the schema-1 lift, the registry, the empty core and household packs
steps.risk: medium; the one hard-to-undo decision (the schema is a contract)
steps.golden_coverage: all cassettes (nothing reads the pack yet: identical replay shows the loader has no side effect); manifest snapshots of S01
steps.notes: contract/pack.py parses and validates the WHOLE schema now (holds lists, unknown_is, remove, questions_default_kind, fleet), so no later step edits it. The loader reads one file per section (`<section>.yaml` next to pack.yaml, a missing file = an empty section) and callables/__init__.py imports every sibling module it finds: a later step adds ITS file and edits no shared one. pyproject package data covers packs/**/*.yaml and packs/**/prompts/*.txt. RobotView gains `pack` and `use_pack(raw)`. Nothing pack-derived may be cached in AssistLoop.__init__. check_manifest (contract layer) validates the section's schema only; the resolved pack is printed by `python -m robot_agent.core.pack.show`.

(1) Verbatim move; assist_loop.py re-exports Places, Memory, words; phases/__init__.py holds PHASE_MIXINS (an empty tuple, one entry per line later) and the class line becomes AssistLoop(*PHASE_MIXINS, WhichOne, ...). (2) tools/lint_arch.py: LOOP becomes the set {assist_loop.py, phases/*.py, places.py, loop_config.py, find_ladder.py, core/pack/*.py} (files that exist), the wiring ratchet counts the SUM over the set (62 keys, 59 branches today), the registered-option-key scan, a new embodiplan-internals scan and a new language-literal scan read the same set (new layers core/pack and packs: 0 rows), and a new vocabulary ratchet counts the quoted standard action names and goal kinds in the set (66 and 59 lines today). Function signatures of lint.wiring / check_wiring / run stay; no existing test is edited; the new checks get their own test file.
